title: improvement: document free_key_priv NULL contract at all call sites
description: wp11_backend.h:115-122 -- NULL free_key_priv means the backend owns key memory in bulk; callers must not free individually. This contract is undocumented at call sites in wp11_pkcs11.c. A future contributor adding a new key-free path could double-free or forget to check. Fix: add a comment at every call site: '/* NULL: backend owns memory in bulk, do not free individually -- see wp11_backend.h:115 */' and add an ASSERT(free_key_priv \!= NULL) if the semantics require it in a given context.
